description: This source file provides a set of support functions for camera capture sessions in Swift, including preparing photo and movie sessions, warming up sessions, handling errors, and configuring camera settings.

methods.name: preparePhotoSession
methods.description: Sets up and returns an AVCaptureSession configured for taking photos, selecting the appropriate camera device.

methods.name: prepareMovieSession
methods.description: Sets up and returns an AVCaptureSession configured for recording movies, with options for including audio and setting duration.

methods.name: prepareWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares a movie session asynchronously, starts the session, warms it up for quicker capture, and returns the session and output.

methods.name: withWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Executes an operation with a warmed-up movie session, ensuring proper startup and cleanup.

methods.name: mapMovieSetupError
methods.description: Maps specific setup errors to more detailed errors, especially handling microphone unavailability.

methods.name: makePhotoSettings
methods.description: Creates and configures photo capture settings, prioritizing quality and supporting JPEG format if available.

methods.name: capturePhotoData
methods.description: Captures photo data asynchronously, using a delegate configured through the provided makeDelegate function.

methods.name: warmUpCaptureSession
methods.description: Delays briefly after starting the capture session to improve photo capture quality.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Converts AVCaptureDevice.Position enum to a human-readable string.
